description: Without `handle`: the current user's own handle (null when they have none) and its public URL. With `handle` ("@name"): the wantlists and tradelists that player published, each with its share URL — read one with read_share_link, or go straight to compare_trade with the handle. Exact match only: there is no search and no list of handles, and an unknown handle answers the same as one with nothing published. This is ANOTHER player's public data: never present it as the current user's own.
